cases.refreshed: The program helps students gain confidence and become effective communicators through interactive public speaking activities, argumentation, and debate. Our volunteer will teach students to learn how to organize persuasive ideas, speak clearly in front of an audience, and think critically. The sessions will be super easy to understand and beginner-friendly, mainly just teaching speech and debate and helping students gain confidence through public speaking. Please note there are 4 sessions. You may sign up for as many as you like! Ages 6-12. Registration recommended!

cases.refreshed: That's right, we're celebrating decorative gourd season for our November Sunday Crafternoon! Just in time for your Thanksgiving decoration needs, we'll have mini faux pumpkins and a variety of mark-making supplies for you to customize these objects to your preferred holiday vibes. While we wait for paint to dry, we'll also craft fake acorns for a bonus decorative element. This project is best for ages 7 and up. Adults are strongly encouraged to join us and get their craft on. Younger participants may need the assistance of a grown-up or older sibling. Supplies are limited, registration required. Sunday Crafternoon: calabazas decoradas ¡Así es! ¡En nuestro Crafternoon (tarde de manualidades) del domingo de noviembre celebraremos la temporada de las calabazas decorativas! Justo a tiempo para decorar tu hogar para el Día de Acción de Gracias, tendremos mini calabazas artificiales y una variedad de materiales para decorarlas a tu gusto y darles el estilo festivo que prefieras. Mientras esperamos a que seque la pintura, también decoraremos bellotas artificiales como detalle adicional. Esta actividad es ideal para niños de 7 años en adelante. ¡Invitamos especialmente a los adultos a participar y disfrutar de esta divertida actividad! Los participantes más pequeños requerirán la ayuda de un adulto o de un hermano mayor.

cases.refreshed: Join us for a Henna program with local artist Rachel-Anne Palacios in honor of Diwali. Learn about this traditional body art, and how to apply henna to yourself. Henna tattoos are temporary, but can last up to 8-10 days. Space is limited. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: Lots and lots of LEGOs... Seriously, a lot. This program is held every third Sunday of the month at Bascom. Create something cool? We can display a photo of it on the library's LCD TV! Ask staff and we'll take a photo of it. For children and families. Registration recommended but not required. Important: Children under 5 must be accompanied by their parents as small LEGO pieces can be choking hazards. LEGO by Alexander Lowe Amazing Vehicles by Rona Skene
